original_evidence.execution: Executed original Python Fraction data model; independently repeated. Five two-layer examples plus reversed submission order, empty and zero-alpha input.
original_evidence.assumptions: Linear non-emissive RGB, scalar alpha in [0,1], fixed fragment set, finite positive contributing weights, and opaque black background for the script. Teaching weights are not a recommended production function.

evidence_boundary: Source-backed mathematical and implementation explanation, with executed original exact-arithmetic checks only. No shader, GPU, engine, visual-quality, performance, target API or human test. Source implementation repositories are not part of this publication's evidence.
